name: Clip Launch Mode
convention: OMX-27: 27 RGB LED keys addressed by key index 0-26, exactly matching the firmware strip.setPixelColor(index, 0xRRGGBB). key 0 = AUX (top-left). keys 1-10 = the 10 black keys (top row). keys 11-26 = the 16 white keys (bottom row). Each led is a colour "#RRGGBB"; "#000000" means the LED is off. keyMap lists each key's musical note. Controls (5 pots, the encoder turn/press, and the 128x32 OLED screen) carry text notes per state. Multiple states are alternative pages/modes of the same hardware.

states.name: Clip Launch (rows orientation, row 5 selected)
states.notes: ONE view with a row/column orientation toggle (the old separate column view is gone). ORIENTATION is a page-1 encoder param on the right of the 8x8 grid (click to select it, click to edit, turn to switch ROW<->COL); it also shows a Clip: Rows / Clip: Cols message. ROWS (shown here): black keys 3-10 select the Launchpad row on keys 11-18, key 3 = row 8 (top) .. key 10 = row 1, matching the OLED grid; keys 19-26 = row-launch, key 19 = row 8. COLUMNS: keys 3-10 select a track column 1-8, keys 11-18 are that column top-down (key 11 = row 8) and keys 19-26 stay row-launch. Keys 1/2 = Clear/Duplicate (msg CLEAR/DUPLICATE); hold both for the Mute chord (3-10 become track mute buttons T1-T8, msg MUTE). Encoder clockwise = next row down (rows) / next column (cols); scrolling the session box is AUX+11/12.
